2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America **Join DaVita Integrated Kidney Care (IKC) as a Care Coordinator**

  

It takes a village to care for our patients, and as a **Care Coordinator (CC)**, you’ll be at the heart of that Village. You’ll be a key player on our care team, helping some of our most complex patients navigate their chronic conditions while ensuring they receive the **highest quality care**. You’ll work closely with Nurse Practitioners and RN Case Managers to coordinate care, facilitate resources, and keep the patient journey moving smoothly.

* **Mileage reimbursed \- reliable personal transportation required**
* **Full\-Time, Monday\-Friday schedule**
* **Daily start time between 7:00\-8:00 AM**
* **Must provide flexibility as needed to meet patient and clinic needs**
* **When working from home \- must include a quiet, private space with high\-speed inter****net**

* Coordinate care for patients by ensuring access to eligible resources/programs and assisting with referrals and provider appointments
* Perform outbound calls and respond to inbound calls from patients, providers, and Village resources
* Complete non\-clinical screenings and pathways under the guidance of the Manager; escalate to Integrated Care Nurse as needed

* Identify eligible resources for members and collaborate with Integrated Care Nurses, dialysis clinics, health plans, and other stakeholders to help members enroll in programs
* Communicate directly with patients in a timely and professional manner
* Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential documentation
* Demonstrate exceptional two\-way communication, both oral and written
* Act in alignment with DaVita’s mission and values to deliver **high\-quality patient care**

 **Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED required
* 2\+ years of experience in a professional office environment
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment
* Strong verbal communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, and Outlook
* Prior experience with Electronic Medical Records preferred
* Commitment to service excellence and patient satisfaction
* Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with the team
* **Home workspace must provide a quiet, private environment with reliable high\-speed internet**

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1\-3 years clinical medical office experience
* CNA or MA experience is a plus
* Experience coordinating care (referrals, care management, etc.)
* Familiarity navigating insurance payers
* Experience in direct patient care or support
* Prior medical office environment experience

 **Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Make a **direct impact** on the lives of patients with complex chronic conditions
* Be part of a mission\-driven, collaborative care team
* Flexible hybrid schedule with opportunity for professional growth

* **Comprehensive benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out
* **Support for you and your family:** Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more

**Job no:** 499053  

**Work type:** Staff Full\-Time  

**Location:** Denver, CO  

**Categories:** Business Operations / Services, Admin / Executive / Office Support, Academic Administration  

**Division:** Natural Sciences and Math  

**About Biological Sciences**



The Department of Biological Sciences focuses on three areas of research and teaching; 1\) Cell and Molecular Biology – including biophysics, neuroscience, cell signaling, and developmental biology, and 2\) Ecology, Biodiversity – including behavioral ecology, plant\-insect interactions, conservation biology, restoration ecology, and evolution and 3\) Physiology of Health and Disease including emphasis on human physiology and exercise physiology. The department offers undergraduate majors of study including Biology (B.A./B.S.), Molecular Biology (B.S./B.S.), Ecology, and Biodiversity (B.A./B.S.) Physiology of Health and Disease (B.S.) and Integrated Sciences (B.A.). A concentration in Cognitive Neurosciences (B.A./B.S.) is also offered in conjunction with the Department of Psychology. At the graduate level, the department offers M.S. and Ph.D. with a research emphasis in either cell and molecular biology or ecology and biodiversity. A professional science masters (PSM) is offered in Biomedical Sciences and a M.S. in Clinical Exercise Physiology.


**About Pre\-Health Education \& Advising**



Pre\-Health Education \& Advising provides academic and career advising for students from all majors who are interested in applying to medical, physician assistant, nursing, dental, pharmacy, physical therapy, and other health\-related graduate programs. Pre\-Health support starts before classes start in the freshman year and continues through all undergrad years and continues after graduation. The goal of advising is to support students in preparing for professional school and building the strongest foundation and the most competitive application/resume possible. Currently, DU has over 400 pre\-health students and also a substantial number of DU alumni who continue to receive pre\-health advising and guidance and assistance in applying to graduate programs.


**Position Summary**



The Prehealth Student Success and Program Coordinator provides comprehensive support for the Department of Biological Sciences and the Pre\-Health Education \& Advising program. This role combines student advising, program coordination, departmental operations, and administrative support to advance student success and ensure effective department operations. * Coordinate administrative operations, communications, and business processes that support the Department of Biological Sciences and Pre\-Health Education \& Advising programs.

* Maintain records, tracking systems, repo Successrts, and documentation to support program assessment and operational effectiveness.
* Provide administrative support for departmental leadership, faculty, staff, and students, including special projects and strategic initiatives.
* Collaborate with campus partners to support facilities, technology, marketing, communications, and other operational needs.
* Support Pre\-Health and graduate programs through the development, maintenance, and enhancement of department websites and Digication content.
* Ensure compliance with university fiscal, administrative, and operational policies.

Description:
**Join Our Caring Community!**


At **We Care Home Health**, we are more than just a healthcare provider—we are a compassionate team dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care and supporting one another. Every team member plays a vital role in our success, and we cultivate a **positive, empowering culture** where you can thrive both professionally and personally.

**Why You'll Love Being Part of Our Team**


At We Care Home Health, we offer a **unique and rewarding** work experience that allows you to provide **meaningful, one\-on\-one patient care** while being part of a **supportive, close\-knit community**. We believe in **open communication, teamwork**, and creating an environment where you can truly make a **difference in the lives of your patients**. If you're a **passionate and skilled Medical Social Worker** who thrives on providing individualized patient care and values making a difference, we would love to have you on our team!

**The Role**


We are seeking a **compassionate and dedicated Medical Social Worker (MSW)** to provide **home\-based social work services** to patients in the **Longmont, Boulder, or Denver Metro area (30\-mile radius).** In this role, you will help patients and their families navigate healthcare challenges, connect them with community resources, and provide emotional support to improve their overall well\-being.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Conducting **assessments of patients' psychosocial status** and developing **individualized care plans**
* Providing **counseling and emotional support** to patients and families facing chronic illness or end\-of\-life care
* Assisting with **financial and resource planning**, including insurance navigation and accessing community services
* Collaborating with the interdisciplinary team to ensure **holistic, patient\-centered care**
* Advocating for patients’ rights and coordinating services to enhance **quality of life**
* Educating patients and families about **available resources, coping strategies, and care options**

**What’s In It for You?**

* **Competitive** pay\-per\-visit \+ mileage **compensation model**
* **Flexible scheduling** to support work\-life balance
* **Pathways for career growth** within a supportive team
* The chance to make a **meaningful impact** on the lives of your patients
* **All employees receive:**
	+ Paid orientation \& training
	+ Paid holidays (as applicable)
	+ Accumulating sick bank
	+ Company\-matching (up to 3%) IRA account
	+ Participation in our **employee recognition platform** for spot bonuses
	+ **Additional benefits** for employees working **24\+ hours/week**, including **medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD\&D, and vacation time accrual**

At We Care Home Health, you'll be part of a **community committed to your professional success** and the well\-being of our patients. We believe in fostering a **positive, empowering culture** where you can grow and **make a difference every day**.

  



***We Care Home Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.*


Requirements:  



**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* **Master’s degree in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited program**
* **Valid Colorado Social Worker license**
* **Experience in home health, hospice, or medical social work preferred**
* **Strong knowledge of community resources, financial assistance programs, and healthcare systems**
* **Exceptional communication, problem\-solving, and advocacy skills**
* **Licensed driver with current auto insurance and a good driving record**

**CITY EQUITY STATEMENT**  

*The City of Westminster welcomes diverse candidates from the broadest base possible. Our goal is to find the best candidate for the job—someone who belongs, not just fits. We value life and professional experiences, recognizing equivalent combinations of knowledge skills and education.*  

  

*Aligned with our city SPIRIT values, the successful candidate will have a passion and commitment to serving a diverse population of residents and must respect and uphold the principles of justice, equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging.*  

  

*We encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for this role, even if you believe you have a less traditional background than described we invite you to apply.*



**POSITION PURPOSE / IMPORTANT APPLICATION INFORMATION**
--------------------------------------------------------


The Program Coordinator II – Youth Advisory Panel (YAP) position is responsible for logistics and communications regarding the City’s Youth Advisory Panel. This position will include interviewing teen volunteer candidates, scheduling YAP meetings and other YAP events, overseeing day\-to\-day activities, visiting local schools, and supervising teens. This position will operate out of College Hill Library and may assist with library or City duties and operations as needed.  

  

The hours available to work in this position are dependent on programming needs with 15\-20 hours per week expected during the school year, including working remotely. The full salary range for this position is stated above. The starting range of pay is dependent on qualifications and experience of each individual candidate.

Our core values are embodied in our SPIRIT (Service – People – Integrity – Respect – Innovation – Teamwork).  

  

This position supports the goals of the Parks, Recreation and Libraries Department, which enhances the quality of life for all Westminster citizens by providing diverse leisure, recreational, and informational services and resources; and acquiring, developing, and maintaining first\-class parks, facilities, open space, and trails. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates. **About the Role**  

  

We are looking for an experienced mental health clinician and leader with a passion for clinical care, quality, supervision, and management to serve as a clinical quality supervisor for our Pediatric virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (vIOP), an accelerated, comprehensive care experience that helps young people ages 7 to 25 feel better quickly from the comfort of home. The pediatric vIOP is a critical service for acute patients who need more than traditional, once\-a\-week therapy. This program is a critical component of our full\-spectrum of care services. It not only helps to avoid re\-hospitalization, but its availability within our services ensures these members have direct access to our core coaching, therapy, and psychiatry services once they are stabilized.



As a vIOP Clinical Quality Supervisor you will spend half the time delivering direct client care and half the time providing management oversight and clinical supervision to vIOP Associate Social Worker (ASW) therapists.


**Direct client care:** You will provide time\-limited, evidence\-based treatment via telehealth. You’ll conduct individual, family, and group skills training sessions, maintaining a caseload of diverse and varied clinical needs. You’ll conduct psych urgent care individual sessions as needed, which consists of risk and safety assessments and developing stabilization plans. An important note: Clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care–an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.


**Clinical supervision and management:** You will help train, manage, and supervise a team of ASW therapists utilizing CBT, DBT, ERP and other evidence\-based practices to support vIOP clients through our innovative video therapy platform. This includes reviewing and providing feedback on clinical quality metrics and consulting on clinical cases. You will also assist with quality improvement initiatives including specialty consultations, provider training, and quality assurance reviews.


**Regularly:** Our vIOP team members enjoy connecting with peers, who share a passion for providing evidence\-based care. You’ll attend one\-on\-one clinical consultation, multidisciplinary team meetings, and robust training to enhance your clinical and supervision skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options–from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care–you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US.


**This role is a great fit** if you have experience supporting pediatric and young adult clients with mood and anxiety disorders in a high acuity (IOP, PHP, residential) setting using evidence\-based and culturally responsive practices, as well as supervising and managing registered ASW’s.



This role reports to our vIOP Clinical Quality Manager.



### **Key Responsibilities**


* Maintain a caseload of vIOP clients, vIOP group sessions, and/or Psych Urgent Care appointments (14 bookable calendar spots)
* Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training of vIOP ASW therapists
* Provide clinical quality oversight, mentoring, clinical and administrative supervision to vIOP ASW therapists in clinical practice
* Provide ongoing feedback regarding ASW therapists’ performance including clinical quality, productivity, adherence to evidence\-based treatment models, client feedback, and interpersonal effectiveness;
* Ensure care provided across the team is culturally responsive and outcomes\-driven;
* Lead ongoing clinical 1:1’s and consultation team meetings with assigned vIOP ASW therapists and consultation teams;
* Provide clinical coverage for vIOP individual and group sessions as needed;
* Other duties as assigned
### **Qualifications**

* Master’s degree from a clinical social work track (LCSW) from an accredited program
* Current unrestricted license to practice in California
* Willingness to obtain cross\-licensing in additional states as needed to support program growth
* 5\+ years postgraduate clinical experience
* Experienced in providing care in a high acuity (IOP, PHP, residential) setting
* Highly skilled in working with clients with severe, co\-occurring clinical diagnoses and high risk presentations
* Highly skilled in providing evidence\-based treatments (e.g., CBT, DBT, ERP, ACT, TF\-CBT, etc.)
* Experienced and passionate about helping kids, teens, young adults, and families to achieve goals
* Experienced in brief, goal\-focused psychotherapy using measurement based care
* 2\+ years of experience in clinical supervision/training of evidence based therapies
* Prior administrative management
* Grounded in cultural humility with a commitment to culturally responsive care
* Experience with video therapy and providing supervision/consultation on how to conduct clinical sessions via video conferencing softwa

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Form Health** is a national telemedicine weight loss clinic specialized in helping patients with obesity lose weight and lead healthier lives. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, but only about 1% of patients receive medical treatment for their disease. The field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth that will see treatment rates surge. Today, Form Health can harness this growth to drive patient impact nationwide. We do this by making research\-based treatment available to patients through the convenience of telehealth, including long\-term care from a specialized physician and dietitian and FDA\-approved medication when appropriate. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.



Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture\-backed startup with an experienced clinical team. Form Health's mission is to empower patients and be the leader in obesity medicine using personalized, research\-based treatment delivered through modern technology. The Patient Care Coordinator role supports physicians, dietitians and patients and is critical to our company mission of outstanding clinical care.


**About the role:**



Form Health's Patient Care Coordinators (PCCs) provide comprehensive support for daily clinical operations, ensuring our patients have a smooth, caring, and well\-organized experience from their very first interaction. Working collaboratively with medical clinicians and registered dietitians, PCCs support processes that enable excellent patient care. This includes a wide range of tasks from managing the patient's care team experience, coordinating patient scheduling, and assisting with benefits coordination, to answering questions regarding prescription fulfillment, and coordinating with external providers. PCCs will also provide essential support to clinicians by managing pre\-visit lab work and inputting vital sign and medical record documentation. We are passionate about helping people improve their health through weight loss and will provide you opportunities for learning and professional growth. This role is 100% remote.


**Where You'll Deliver Impact:**



We seek an experienced Medical Assistant, a collaborative team player with exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills, who is passionate about being part of a healthcare team and excited to work in a non\-traditional telemedicine practice environment. Ultimately, your role is about being organized, thoughtful, and empathetic, making sure every patient feels personally supported at every step of their journey.


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Care Team Management:**


* Acting as the primary point of contact to maintain communication flow between patients and their care team.
* Receiving, triaging, and resolving incoming clinical messages from patients to clinicians, and relaying messages from clinicians to patients as requested.
* Conducting regular outgoing patient communications to ensure consistent engagement and optimize their success in the program.
* Providing routine administrative support for clinicians
* Contributing to special projects as directed, helping to improve our systems and make care more efficient and effective.


**Lab / Medical Records Support:**


* Helping collect medical records from primary care or other providers when needed.
* Requesting medical records.
* Reviewing patient uploaded medical records.
* Facilitating Medical Records \& Prescriptions, including sending lab requisitions.
* Assisting with prior authorization coordination and other prescription\-related tasks.
* Assisting with medication refills and pharmacy questions.
* Supporting medical clinicians with pre\-visit lab orders.


**Membership / Program Status:**


* Guiding new patients through what to expect, both at the start and throughout their weight loss journey.
* Addressing general questions about the program.
* Supporting patients with account changes or cancellation requests.
* Providing feedback and communicating patient feedback to other company teams (i.e. Product, Engineering, Marketing) to improve operational tools and patient care.
* Assisting with clinical data collection as needed to track company's key clinical performance indicators or for quality improvement purposes.
* Providing scheduling and appointment support for patients.


**Billing / Insurance:**


* Assisting with general insurance and billing questions.
* Providing information regarding insurance coverage updates.
* Addressing billing concerns and coordinating with the billing department.
* Answering membership change questions related to billing.
* Providing information on the cost of memberships.
* Answering eligibility questions.


**You'll Be Successful in This Role Because You Have:**


* A Medical Assistant (MA) Certificate is required: **Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) from the American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)** *or* **Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) from the American Medical Technologists (AMT)** *or* **Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) from the National Healthcareer Association (NHA).**
* At least two years of experience in a fast\-paced primary care, obesity medicine, or endocrinology practice.
* Experience with prescription prior authorization processes is a plus.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Highly organized with a proven ability to manage multiple tasks and time effectively.
* Proficient computer skills, with proficiency in platforms such as Slack and Google Workspace, and the ability to quickly adapt to evolving, custom\-built IT systems.


**More about FORM's benefits:**


* Competitive salary and equity in a high growth start\-up
* Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
* 401k
* Flexible work schedules and paid time off
* Paid parental leave

jobs.title: Care Coordinator - LPN/CMA/RMA
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Enable Healthcare Inc. is a nationwide provider of remote patient health services strictly following CMS service guidelines. We work with an array of clients ranging from small practices to large health systems.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are currently seeking Care Coordinators to join our team!

The ideal Care Coordinator will possess excellent communication skills and be able to organize and maintain their own schedule, while working well with a diverse group of people.

Our Care Coordinators are specifically trained to work with patients to help manage their chronic conditions and coach healthier lifestyle choices as directed by the comprehensive care plan created by their physician. They are an extension of the provider to help close the gaps in your patient’s care. As a part of our amazing team of Care Coordinators, you will build a rapport with your patients through monthly calls as you support them through services such as Chronic Care Management (CCM) and Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM).

Furthermore, you will empower patients to meet their goals, guide them in their healthcare journey and advocate for their needs by utilizing active listening skills, investigating patient concerns, documenting appropriately, and communicating professionally with their clinician to advocate a resolution to those needs.

By joining our organization, you will help grow your career in healthcare, and help us complete our mission: healthier and more satisfied patients.

**Primary Responsibilities**

The Care Coordinator performs care management for chronically ill patients with chronic diseases such as chronic kidney disease, diabetes mellitus, hypertension, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and/or congestive heart failure.

The Care Coordinator works in collaboration and continuous partnership with clinic providers and community resources in a team approach to increase patients’ ability for self\-management and shared decision\-making. You will identify resources and coordinate needs for chronic care management patients.

* Resolve patients' questions and create an open dialogue to understand needs
* Identify and coordinate community resources with patients that would benefit their care
* Provide patient education and health literacy on the management of chronic conditions
* Assist with medication management, including identifying potential medication concerns, adherence, and coordinating refills
* Manage and support patients' healthcare needs via phone conversations
* Ensure that daily production goals and quality metrics are met within standards set forth by Enable Healthcare Inc.
* Maintain contact with patients to provide care coordination, support, and manage compliance with the care management programs to increase positive outcomes
* Document all communications with patients and their providers accurately
* Communicate to practice care clinicians regarding patient needs and/or life\-threatening episodes to ensure comprehensive care plans are complete and accurate
* Adhere to documentation protocols (SOPs) and best practices for daily workflow, escalation of client issues, and internal communications
* Demonstrate an ability to develop and build trusting relationships with patients and partner practices with a true passion for caring for patients and guiding them in their health journeys
* Have an ability to stay flexible and quickly adapt to new processes, software changes, and priorities with a positive attitude and a willingness to learn new skills on a continuous basis
* Must be an empathetic and active listener with the ability to thrive both as a team member and independently in a fast\-paced environment

**Requirements**

* Active LPN License/CMA or RMA Certification
* Must have a home office or HIPAA compliant workspace, someplace secure where you have complete privacy to protect PHI
* Must have high\-speed internet

**Benefits**

* Earn monthly bonus once eligible
* Full time Care Coordinators are eligible for benefits after 90 days of continuous employment
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Fully Remote Position

**Skills Required**

* Advanced clinical acumen
* Ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced work environment
* Flexibility to fluidly transition and adjust in an evolving role
* Excellent organizational skills
* Advanced oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills
* Compassion and desire to advocate for patient needs
* Critical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities

Job Type: Full\-Time

Salary: $42,000 to 45,000\.00 /year ($20\.19\-$21\.63 per hour) \- LPN based on experience or, $18\.00/hour \- CMA/RMA

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $37,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

License/Certification:

* Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) Multistate LPN License (Required)
* RMA (Required)
* Certified Medical Assistant (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Grant Writer & Federal Funding Specialist (SAM.gov/Grants.gov)
jobs.description:
Grant Writer \& Federal Funding Specialist (SAM.gov/Grants.gov)

New Leaf Peer Support LLC is seeking an experienced, detail\-oriented Grant Writer and Federal Funding Specialist to help identify and pursue funding for our behavioral\-health and community\-support programs.

This is a part\-time, remote independent\-contractor position with the potential to grow.

About New Leaf

New Leaf Peer Support LLC provides mental\-health counseling, intensive outpatient services, case management, resource navigation, and community outreach. We serve adults experiencing mental\-health challenges, substance\-use concerns, homelessness or housing instability, reentry from incarceration, and transitions from hospitals or treatment programs.

Responsibilities

* Research federal, state, local, foundation, and corporate grant opportunities **Identify grants that fit our programs, population, location, and eligibility** Write clear, competitive grant applications and proposals **Manage application deadlines and required documents** Assist with SAM.gov entity registration, renewals, user roles, and compliance **Understand Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) requirements** Navigate Grants.gov and federal grant workspaces **Help organize budgets, narratives, supporting documents, and attachments** Review funding notices and explain requirements to leadership **Track submitted, pending, awarded, and denied applications** Assist with grant reporting, compliance, and renewal requirements **Help develop a long\-term funding calendar and grant strategy**

Required Qualifications

* Demonstrated grant\-writing experience **Experience using SAM.gov and Grants.gov** Knowledge of federal grant registration and application requirements **Strong research, writing, editing, and organizational skills** Ability to manage multiple deadlines independently **Experience preparing grant narratives, budgets, and supporting documentation** Ability to explain complicated requirements in clear language

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience securing grants for behavioral health, mental health, substance\-use treatment, housing stability, homelessness, reentry, or community programs **Familiarity with SAMHSA, HRSA, HUD, DOJ, state, county, and foundation grants** Experience with nonprofit organizations, small businesses, or healthcare providers **A record of successfully funded applications**

When Applying

Please submit:

* Your resume
* A brief description of your SAM.gov and Grants.gov experience
* Examples of grants you have written
* The number and total value of grants you have helped secure
* Your hourly rate and weekly availability
* Whether you have experience with behavioral\-health or community\-service grants

Schedule: Part\-time, flexibleHours: Approximately 10–15 hours per weekLocation: RemoteCompensation: $ hour, based on experienceEmployment Type: Independent contractor

Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
